quotes.decision: `verify_claim_against_contract` is pure Python — stop- word filtering, Jaccard similarity, constraint-denial pattern detection. Returns `NLIGroundingScore` (Entailment / Contradiction / Neutral) with a `logical_meaning` string. No LLM inside.
quotes.title: Tooled deterministic CoVe — no LLM in verification (inherits v1 ADR-006)

quotes.decision: Every read-only data class uses `model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")`. Includes: VCDeps, VCDepsCompact, StaticEnterpriseContractBaselines, Tier1Result, Tier2Result, Tier3Result, Committee, every input model.
quotes.title: `frozen=True` Pydantic config on all read-only data classes

quotes.decision: `node_open_hitl` calls `langgraph.interrupt`. The caller (`run_validation_workflow`) returns the ValidationReport at the interrupt snapshot.
quotes.title: LangGraph `interrupt/Command(resume=…)` for HITL pause/resume

quotes.decision: Every test in `tests/` is hermetic: - `TestModel` for tests that just assert the agent ran and emitted a schema-valid output. - `FunctionModel(callable)` for tests that need to script specific tool-call sequences (e.g. ADR-051's parallel-fanout assertion).
quotes.title: Hermetic tests via pydantic-ai `TestModel` / `FunctionModel`

quotes.decision: Collect everything observability-related into one package, `validation_workflow.observability`, with a clean three-layer internal split: - `observability.events` — the contract.
quotes.title: Observability abstraction: `validation_workflow.observability` is the single integration point

quotes.decision: Wrap the Judge in two deterministic CoVe layers with a configurable retry-on-Contradiction loop (`pipeline/cove_loop.py`): 1.
quotes.title: Two-layer CoVe with retry (the Judge weighs, the verifier filters)

quotes.decision: All NI outbound is proposed by the machine, sent only after a reviewer confirms: - The engine stays IO-agnostic (CLAUDE.md rule 8): nodes COMPOSE drafts, they do not send.
quotes.title: HITL-gated NI outbound: no agent emails the NI without a human
